item.title: Pendant Public Bar, Collingwood - The City Lane
item.description: Pendant Public Bar is a dog-friendly Ftizroy pub that combines a classic pub atmosphere with excellent drinks, and friendly vibes.

item.title: Aegli, South Melbourne - The City Lane
item.description: Aegli is a modern South Melbourne Greek restaurant. Food is inspired by Greek recipes and flavours, with exciting and unexpected twists.

item.title: Paris Street Art Guide - The City Lane
item.description: Paris is one of the best European cities for street art. My Paris street art guide will show you the best places to find street art in Paris.

item.title: Nileos House, Thiseio - The City Lane
item.description: Nileos House, is a modern, serviced apartment in Athens' Thiseio neighbourhood. It's well located for exploring Athens.

item.title: Flying Jetstar Economy Class From Sydney To Seoul - The City Lane
item.description: Jetstar runs daily flights between Sydney and Seoul. Here's my review on flying Jetstar Economy Class from Sydney to Seoul.

item.title: North 54, Leederville - The City Lane
item.description: Visit Leederville's North 54 for a contemporary take on banh mi and other tasty Vietnamese snacks and favourites.

item.title: Ginza Nana Alley, Perth CBD - The City Lane
item.description: Ginza Nana Alley is a five venue laneway space in Perth that recreates the vibe and quality of Tokyo's food and drink yokocho.

item.title: Hydra, The Perfect Day Trip Greek Island - The City Lane
item.description: Hydra (also known as Ydra, or Idra is a small, peaceful Greek Island. It's perfect for a day trip from Athens, only an hour from Piraeus.

item.title: Daphne, Brunswick East - The City Lane
item.description: Daphne Brunswick East is a casual diner and bar. Visit for a relaxed vibe with Italo-Euro inspired food and quality drinks.

item.title: Gerald's Bar, Carlton North - The City Lane
item.description: Gerald's Bar has opened in a new, larger space in Carlton North. Visit for good food, drink, and a vibrant space.
